target.statement: Misclassification rate of cellGMM on the Homogenized Meat data set with 3% cellwise contamination (0% missing), reported as 0.01 in Table 2.
target.dataset: Homogenized Meat data set (McElhinney et al., 1999), 231 samples, 5 selected wavelengths

compute.basis: Small data set (231x5) and a pure-R EM implementation; the paper reports cellGMM.penb taking ~1-5 seconds per run on a laptop, so a few runs plus installation and data loading fit easily in under an hour.

blockers: The GitHub repository may not include the exact data preprocessing (wavelength selection) or the random contamination seed used in the paper, so the exact 0.01 value may not be bit-reproducible.
The meat data set is public but may require manual download and formatting.
title: Cellwise outlier detection in heterogeneous populations
